horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Juma y el raudal de Jidïma. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P27 — Juma · anciano. Juma elder: very slim aged body, LONG lined narrow face, straight grey CHIN hair. Preserve source GREEN LEAF waist garment with overlapping whole paper leaves, not standard cream loincloth. ONE small cobalt feather earring and fine pale QUILL septum pin, no large crown or necklace. Optional complete long WHITE feather-paper cape rests by him, if requested. Green / white / tiny cobalt identity; same identifiable face and eyes across age/gender transformations, no mandatory crown for child state.
Reference 2: O08 — Abeï ïgï · capa de Juma. 
Reference 3: L09 — Raudal de Jidïma. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide misty low Amazonian river flowing toward a distant raudal. ONE whole very slim elder Juma matching P27, grey chin hair, layered GREEN LEAF waist garment, small cobalt side feather and fine pale nasal pin, walks on a low root bank looking toward ONE complete WHITE feather-paper cape O08 caught on a distant branch above the water. The cape is a narrative visual proposition from the bible, not a documentary reconstruction. Its edge becomes a short silver-blue water ribbon pointing toward the raudal: editorial route visualization. No modern coat, superhero costume, mountains, multiple age states or giant elder. Whole person and cape, quiet pursuit.

VISIBLE CHECK: Juma anciano completo sigue una capa blanca hacia el raudal.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 25 percent so ALL FOUR adults fit entirely within the vertical canvas, including the leftmost woman full head, shoulder, arm and transforming feet. Preserve the elderly Juma at right, his nasal quill, cobalt ear feather and leaf skirt, the whole connecting white feather cape, other original adults, rock-transforming feet and flowing rapids. Recenter the group with visible margin on both sides. No additional people, no new ornaments.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Juma y el raudal de Jidïma. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: V20 — Jidïma: comunidad y rocas. 
Reference 2: L09 — Raudal de Jidïma. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE broad winding BLUE RIVER RIBBON folds around three simple grey PAPER ROCKS. The rocks' ONE connected shadow on the river looks like a chain of complete clasped HUMAN SILHOUETTES, no physical people or recognizable copied faces. Original editorial metaphor for a raudal inhabited by a halted community. Main motif is the connected river/rock memory, not a postcard waterfall. Soft silver ripples, deep jungle green and white feather-like edges quietly echo Juma's recovered cape. No glyphs, tourists, diagram, mountains, bones or three model-sheet panels.

VISIBLE CHECK: Rocas en un cauce producen una sola sombra de comunidad enlazada.
